FVFGV FGFGD XVVVA VXFXV DVFFX FGVFD VGVAD FAGGG

records.header_literal: B) ZON v CV (06.33 p.m., December 3d); 2130 (30/11); RICHI-136
records.readable_german: Inspektion und Kriegsministerium verstaendigt. Antwort steht noch aus. Papp.
records.meaning: The inspection and the War Ministry have been notified; a reply is still outstanding. Signed Papp.
notes: The page is headed 30 November; the intercept annotation says December 3 and the service line says 2130 (30/11). These are separate source dates.
A small mark after the last V of VVGFV is not counted as a sixth coordinate. The source count is exactly 136.

records.title: Station dismantling notice with a printed variant
source_rows: XAFFV GFVVV DVGFF GAAFD GDAAF VAXAA XDDDF
DDDXV DDVFD FFDVX GXFGV XAXDX XXXGF VVXGV VXVFV
records.header_literal: C) CV v ZON (11.15 p.m., December 6th); 1900 (30/11); RIZI-78; XAFFV (or XVFFV)
records.readable_german: Station baut 0ZXJ frueh 9 Uhr ab. Burkard.
records.meaning: A station announces when it will dismantle. The printed key labels do not establish the historical day or hour; Burkard is the literal signature.
notes: The source explicitly prints XAFFV (or XVFFV). Both complete 78-slot frames are decrypted and re-encrypted. Their only output difference is position 15: Y versus Z. Neither version is silently selected as historically authentic.

The readable text uses the first printed variant. Its literal field 0ZXJ and its hour label 9 stay unassigned. Under the alternative, the token immediately before FRUEH is 0ZXJZ rather than 0ZXJ followed by Y.
The intercept annotation says December 6; the service line says 1900 (30/11).

records.header_literal: D) NKJ v LP (05.47 p.m., December 4th); Fuer COS 1225 (30/11); RICHI-188
records.readable_german: Zentralfunkleitg erbitten Nachricht ueber Verbleib Funker und Baupersonal der Funkenstation Tiflis. 54X05.
records.meaning: The central radio command asks where the radio operators and construction personnel of the Tiflis station have gone. The final 54X05 remains a literal reference.
notes: ZENTRALFUNKLEITG is kept as the transmitted abbreviation; the readable display does not insert its omitted letters.
The source header says December 4; the service line says Fuer COS 1225 (30/11).

records.title: Request for timely internment notification
source_rows: VDDFA GFVVV AVFFV FVAGV GVVFV FVVFX AXFAG GVXFG
AFAVF VGFGA GDXAF DFFFA GVGGF GGAVF AFFVV GVVAF
records.header_literal: E) ZON v CV (04.43 p.m., December 6th); 0930 (30/11); RICHI-88
records.meaning: Give timely notification here of the internment. Signed Papp. The short message does not name the persons or formation to be interned.
notes: The intercept annotation says December 6; the service line reads 0930 (30/11). The earlier OCR gave 0830, which is not retained as the primary source transcription.

prior_credit: Published period keys: George Lasry, Ingo Niebel, Nils Kopal and Arno Wacker (2016), and George Lasry (2017 key list). Earlier unreviewed repository candidates are preserved separately. This is a source edition and explicit repair review, not a claim of universal first-decipherment priority.
limits: All source slots are used in order; no missing group, inserted coordinate, deletion, swap or transposition change is proposed.
Digits and rare-letter labels remain literal; output agreement under a stated square does not establish historical numeral values.
Source-image comparison authenticates crop location and bytes, not the historical correctness of a proposed editorial word.
